en_US: What’s this? Team Rocket has
come back?
I saw some men in black at the
Lake of Rage.
I stop my Pokémon from evolving too
early.
I make them learn certain moves before
I let them evolve.
Pokémon do become stronger when they
evolve, but they also learn moves
more slowly.
Young man, you should treat your
Pokémon in a manner fit for a king!
Maybe this little accessory will
allow you to do so!
Young lass, you should treat your
Pokémon in a manner fit for a king!
Maybe this little accessory will
allow you to do so!
A King’s Rock will give your Pokémon
regal beauty!
Although, I have also heard allowing
the crown to touch certain Pokémon
can cause instantaneous evolution...
